description: This file defines and registers a plugin for the StepFun provider, including configuration, authentication methods, and catalog resolution logic.

methods.name: trimExplicitBaseUrl
methods.description: Trims and returns the explicit base URL for a given provider ID from the context configuration.

methods.name: inferRegionFromBaseUrl
methods.description: Infers the region ('cn' or 'intl') based on the provided base URL.

methods.name: inferRegionFromProfileId
methods.description: Infers the region based on the profile ID string.

methods.name: inferRegionFromEnv
methods.description: Infers the region based on environment variables.

methods.name: inferRegionFromExplicitBaseUrls
methods.description: Infers region from explicit base URLs for provider and plan.

methods.name: resolveDefaultBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the default base URL based on surface type and region.

methods.name: resolveStepFunCatalog
methods.description: Resolves the provider catalog configuration based on context and parameters.

methods.name: resolveProfileIds
methods.description: Returns profile IDs based on the region.

methods.name: createStepFunApiKeyMethod
methods.description: Creates an API key authentication method for StepFun provider.
